PENDING_FRAMEWORK_LIFTS:
  - Phase 3 .env templates should default AUTH_TRUST_HOST=true for non-Vercel deployments
    (Komodo + Traefik stack always qualifies). Tracked via 🟡 fix lesson 2026-05-07.
  - Browser-interactive Visual QA needs system Chrome — unblock at first UI Phase 7.
  - Vitest + Auth.js v5 helper-extraction rule — tracked via 🔴 gotcha lesson 2026-05-08.
    Future TDD on any middleware-adjacent helper must extract to apps/web/src/lib/<name>.ts
    BEFORE writing the test, never import "@/middleware" from a unit test.
  - Reverse JE procedure could be hardened with db.$transaction (matches existing 'post' which
    also lacks transaction wrapping). Defer until first concurrent-write incident.
  - Prisma create-call mock-vs-typecheck gap (2026-05-08 🟢 change → recurring 🔴 gotcha 2026-05-08):
    Vitest mocks don't enforce required Prisma fields OR field NAMES; only tsc catches missing
    createdById, wrong field names like reportedById vs userId, or wrong cast targets like
    Plan.code vs Plan.slug. Tests with these bugs PASS at vitest. Pattern recurred Item 2 →
    Item 3. Recommend either: (a) tests assert expect.objectContaining({ data: expect.object
    Containing({ <required fields> }) }), or (b) typecheck must run BEFORE marking RED→GREEN
    cycle complete (not just at end-of-session validation gate).
  - Conditional spread pattern (NEW 2026-05-08 🟢 change lesson):
    For partial Prisma create/update inputs with optional nullable fields under
    exactOptionalPropertyTypes, prefer ...(input.x !== undefined && { x: input.x }) inline
    over Record<string, unknown> + as Parameters<typeof X>[0]['data'] cast. Cleaner code,
    no ESLint suppression needed, same semantics. Apply going forward.
  - Prisma typed-args inference loss (NEW 2026-05-08 🔴 gotcha):
    args: Parameters<typeof prisma.X.findMany>[0] = { select: ... } widens the select type
    to the full union, dropping specific include-shape inference. Use shared
    `const SELECT = {...} as const;` + explicit if/else branches calling findMany twice
    instead. Cost: ~5 LOC duplication; benefit: TypeScript flows correct row type.
